correctness.rationale: The exact barycentric identity Q=m/(m-1)(1+S-2M) is proved from regular-simplex Gram entries. All required Dirichlet moments are integrated with explicit finite integrals; the nonstandard E[MS] is derived via translated-simplex inclusion-exclusion and independently checked using exact ordered-simplex monomial integration. Limits follow from the exponential representation, law of large numbers and Gumbel maximum law; variance limit follows from exact finite formula. Exact rational program passed 15 dimensions plus two endpoint cases; finite computations alone are not used as proof.

originality.rationale: The derived positive mixed covariance of maximum Dirichlet(1) coordinate and sum of squared coordinates is not contained in the inspected marginal-spacing formulas. It produces an exact all-dimensional variance for regular-simplex nearest-vertex squared distortion and its scaled Gumbel limit. Prior exact maximum moments, simplex centroidal moments and unrelated projection-width Gumbel limits are explicitly credited. No historically exhaustive claim is made.
residual_risks: An obscure pre-2016 spacing, concentration, or finite-code quantization article could state an equivalent mixed moment or variance; available searches do not establish worldwide novelty.

value.rationale: This is a naturally motivated second-order performance invariant of an explicit finite vertex quantizer on a regular simplex. The variance, positive-but-vanishing structural covariance, and sharp m^{-1} non-Gaussian fluctuation law reveal uncertainty not encoded by the previously tabulated mean nearest-vertex error or maximum-spacing moments. The exact cross moment is necessary and not a mere parameter substitution; no downstream theorem is claimed.
